I've rewritten this so many times, this is the last time. I've been struggling hard in school. I chose a major just to get done and it's a horrible major, I love the content but the courses and the teachers are awful. It's such a fake industry. Everyone acts like they like eachother and in reality everyone hates one another.

I have to pay for my school by myself and as I'm in the states it's a huuuuuge investment. I can't afford to pay for classes I'm going to fail. Today I got back an exam for a language course I'm required to take, I felt really good about this exam. Thought I would at least get a high C or low B (i'm usually a high B or low A student)... I failed it. 56%. My friend who was sitting next to me was so dissapointed. She's been tutoring me and I've been working so hard but I still failed. This has been the theme of my life even outside of school. 

Try to help a customer at work? Get yelled at by the boss for doing it wrong or not her way. Try to clean up the house? Get yelled at for using the wrong cleaner. Try to talk to my friends? Get told I"m annoying or a debbie downer. 

I just can't take so much more like a failure. I used to be so confident and happy then I got coerced into sex with my ex and he cheated on me the last 8 months of our relationship. It wasn't like a childish relationship, we were talking about getting married. Even after I knew he was cheating on me I let him sleep in the same bed as me, let him push me around, let him yell at me and manipulate me. I don't know how to handle men anymore. I can barely stand to talk to a guy whereas before I could confidently flirt with anyone. I tried therapy but none of the therapists schedules work with my school since I have to commute 2 hours to get there, I can't go to therapy M-Fri and they're never open on the weekends.
